learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about the different shapes of land like towering mountains, flat plains, and high plateaus, and discover how people live there!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Mountains are huge landforms that rise high above the surrounding land. They often have steep slopes and a pointy top called a peak. The Himalayas are a great example!
Imagine a mountain with its top chopped off so it is flat! That is a plateau. It is an elevated flat land, also known as a tableland. They are rich in minerals.
Plains are large areas of flat land. Rivers bring rich soil here, making plains perfect for farming and building big cities. Most people in the world live on plains.
The place we live decides our lifestyle. People in mountains might build sloping roofs for snow, while people in plains grow lots of crops like wheat and rice.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Play-Doh Earth Builder
fun_activity.instructions: Use play-dough or clay to build your own mini-world! Make a pointy mountain, a flat plateau next to it, and a low green plain at the bottom.

quick_recap: ⭐ The Earth's surface is uneven and has different shapes called landforms.
⭐ Mountains are high, plateaus are flat on top, and plains are low, flat lands.
⭐ Plains are highly populated because they are great for farming and building homes.
